architecture: Input log10(gates)/10. Shared32/shared88 SiLU+linear skip; local8 has8units perchannel and only that channel gates; linear has learned full18x11map+bias, no fixed powers. All initialized from same first32 hidden features and same skip perseed; fit mean log-opening bias. Exact same sampled rows.
loss_definition: hybrid=log10(pred+1e-30)MSE/900+openingMSE; raw_log=(raw_log10-target_log10)^2/900 before clamp/exp. Raw-log contrast jointly removes output-transform conditioning and absolute component; do not attribute exclusively to one. All outputs10^min(raw,0). Common development score is clipped-output logMSE/900+absoluteMSE, earliest ties. Fit-only bias and pool; freeze before fresh.
diagnostics: Report raw-log residual separately from clipped-output loss and fraction raw>0. Learned least-squares linear regression on fit log-gates to fit log-openings, no known powers supplied, evaluated on fresh as separate solver control; not an automatically deployable model. Exact analytic oracle retained as nonselectable control.

hypotheses.claim: Locality helps when local capacity is not starved.
hypotheses.contrast: local8/shared88 equal hidden budget but different masks; shared32 only secondary comparison.
raw_log/hybrid at fixedarchitecture; compound contrast disclosed.

hypotheses.claim: Nonlinear parameterization obstructs this log-linear target.
hypotheses.contrast: learned linear Adam vs learned least-squares and nonlinear arms; no analytic powers fitted into candidates.

cost.scope: Packed neural readout vs exact product, not matched workload or full-neuron speedup.

limitations: Static full physical state only. No temporal/latent-memory qualification; reachable and synthetic separated. Updated data prevents strict cross-run attribution. Original amplitude thresholds unchanged; rawlog metric only diagnostic. Fit least-squares not proof of SGD learnability.
